AI Notes.value: Multidisciplinary graphic design and art direction studio founded 2015 by Kevin Fortin (graphic designer, ex-LISAA Nantes, ex-Marcel Worldwide/Publicis) and Theo Viardin (artist/designer, studied graphic design Nantes and Toulouse). Based in Bagnolet, Paris. Studio dissolved Sept 2023 per business registry; website (studio-embuscade.fr) and Instagram (@studio_embuscade) both offline as of July 2026. Work spans graphic identity, editorial, typography, photography, motion/video, and web. Key documented projects: FFHB (French Handball Federation) social media identity system 2019, plus motion graphics for Coupe de France 2018/2019 and Golden League 2020, screened at Accor Hotels Arena; Tarot imaginaire for Liquides Imaginaires perfume brand (2017), a 15-card illustrated tarot system mapping each fragrance to a tarot card; Le Castor Astral publishing house identity and editorial system (2016); Petit Navire restaurant identity 2019 (maritime/drakkar theme). Captured work is from Vimeo (4 video thumbnails + embeds). Project-depth images (FFHB social templates, Castor Astral book covers, Petit Navire branding) are inaccessible: live site is ECONNREFUSED, Wayback Machine HTML lists the image filenames but they are not independently archived (im_ URLs return 404), and Wayback-rendered pages display blank due to JS-external dependency.
